title: Causal Concept Explanations for Deep Neural Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14407v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Concept-based explanations in neural models are important for the development, certification, and adoption of autonomous systems. Yet, interpretability remains correlational. Without methods to guide and quantify causal relationships between explanations, a concept explanation can be provided without being necessary or sufficient for the observed output thereby appearing correct while misleading. We introduce Causal Concept Wrapper Network (CCW-Net), the first use of interventional mediation analysis from fields such as economics, medicine, and epidemiology as a training objective to align causal effects of concept-based explanations with a model's output. We further apply mediation analysis as an evaluation tool to quantify, per concept label combination, how much of any model's output is causally attributable to each concept explanation. translated_title: 深度神经网络模型的因果概念解释
translated_abstract: 神经网络模型中基于概念的解释对于自主系统的开发、认证和推广应用至关重要。然而，现有的可解释性方法仍停留在相关性层面。由于缺乏指导和量化解释之间因果关系的方法，所提供的概念解释可能既不是所观测输出的必要条件，也不是其充分条件，从而在看似正确的同时产生误导。我们提出了因果概念包装网络（Causal Concept Wrapper Network, CCW-Net），这是首次将源自经济学、医学和流行病学等领域的干预性中介分析用作训练目标，使基于概念的解释的因果效应与模型输出保持一致。我们还进一步将中介分析用作评估工具，针对每个概念标签组合，量化任意模型输出中有多少可因果归因于每个概念解释。作为训练目标，CCW-Net 塑造模型的概念表示，使其既能……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 CCW-Net，首次将干预性中介分析作为训练目标，使概念解释与模型输出之间建立真正的因果关系而非仅是相关性，并提供量化每个概念解释对模型输出因果贡献的评估工具。
